description: 한국공항공사_김포공항 실내주차장 빈 주차면 실시간 안내 정보_GW [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국공항공사. 인천국제공항을 제외한 전국 14개 공항을 운영하는 한국공항공사(Korea Airports Cooperation)에서 김포공항 국제선 실내주차장의 모든 주차면의 주차 가능여부를 실시간으로. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국공항공사. Its tags are 김포공항 국제선 실내주차장, 실내주차장 빈 주차면, 네비게이션 빈 주차장 안내, 공항 주차 가능 여부, 공항 주차장 주차면 상태. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
